gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-008 identifies the same lemma and quotient formula defect: the product identity does not justify division by I(p), because I(p) may vanish at an allowed continuously differentiable real eigenpair, producing an undefined 0/0 expression. It also gives the matching repair of retaining the product identity and restricting the quotient to I(p)≠0.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries identify the invalid unconditional division by I(p) in the derivative formula and the resulting undefined quotient at admissible zero-effect points.

component_coverage.gold_component: The lemma claims a quotient formula for all covered real continuously differentiable points even though the proof establishes only the product balance; admissible I(p)=0 cases make the quotient undefined, so division requires I(p)≠0.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states that the derived product identity does not justify division by I(p), supplies an admissible smooth family with I=0 where the quotient is 0/0, and prescribes the exact repair: state the product identity generally and the quotient only when I(p)≠0.
